Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 池州春送前进士蒯希逸 — 杜牧
芳草复芳草，断肠还断肠。
自然堪下泪，何必更残阳。
楚岸千万里，燕鸿三两行。
有家归不得，况举别君觞。
